metadata.description: PM Co-Pilot: a personal operating system for Claude that learns you and runs your weekly overhead.

plugins.name: pm-copilot
plugins.description: Turns Claude into a co-pilot that knows your context, remembers your decisions, and runs your morning brief, weekly prep, open-loops, and self-improvement whenever you need them. Tool-agnostic: it adapts to your chat, task, email, calendar, and notes tools at setup.
